headline: 11-Year-Old Boy Dies After Being Struck By Ute In Kirup, WA
seoTitle: 11-Year-Old Boy Killed in Kirup Ute Crash
metaDescription: An 11-year-old boy has died in hospital following a collision with a ute on the South Western Highway in the Western Australian town of Kirup.
aiSummaryBullets: An 11-year-old boy sustained fatal injuries after being hit by a Toyota Hilux.
The incident occurred on the South Western Highway in the town of Kirup.
Authorities are investigating the collision on the regional transit route.
aiContextParagraph: The incident took place on the South Western Highway, a major thoroughfare located in Kirup, a small town situated approximately 220 kilometers south of Perth in Western Australia. According to reports from the scene, an 11-year-old boy was crossing the highway when he was struck by a Toyota Hilux utility vehicle driven by a woman. Emergency services responded to the scene, and the child was subsequently transported to a hospital to receive treatment for his injuries, where he later died. Local authorities are currently examining the circumstances surrounding the fatal collision, which occurred on a road noted for being a popular travel route for those visiting the state's South West region. No further details regarding the driver or the specific events leading up to the impact have been released by officials at this time.
